title: Dodona oracular lead tablets (questions to Zeus Naios and Dione); RU «Вопросы к оракулу Додоны»
author: Anonymous consultants (private individuals and cities)
edition: Dakaris–Vokotopoulou–Christidis 2013 (2 vols, Athens; copyrighted); Lhôte 2006 (Droz); early public-domain: Carapanos, Dodone et ses ruines (1878, archive.org)
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka ('Додона', 'оракульные таблички Додоны') shows only studies (2019 sanctuary article; 2026 article on divination); no translation collection found.
en_evidence: Eidinow, Oracles, Curses and Risk (2007): catalogue of 'upwards of 150' questions with translations (BMCR 2008.01.14). Wikipedia: 4,200+ tablets.
other_translations: French: Lhôte 2006, Les lamelles oraculaires de Dodone (selection)
value: A unique set of first-person questions from ordinary Greeks about marriage, children, health, travel, slaves and business, plus city consultations. Important for religion, mentalities and dialectology. Very attractive for students and general readers; ideal showcase.
ai_feasibility: medium: short texts, but dialects, local alphabets, palimpsests and heavy restoration. The AI should translate the editors' readings and mark uncertainty. Copyright: cite the 2013 readings with attribution.
pilot_unit: 200 best-preserved questions (Lhôte's set cross-checked against 2013 corpus), c. 4–5k words
